name: selfcheck-appstats
_comment: Real-app code path on the standalone target (node tools/load/target.mjs --renditions 720p, then --target-state <dir>/state.json): WHEP through the shim's app-like proxy, the shim's GET /api/stats (contract v 1) as the ONLY target statistics (MediaMTX API not used), quality mix source/720p judged per quality, churn with re-joins that stop at the hold end, chat, and one desktop browser page in a separate phase after stage 1. Short holds for a quick check of the tool, not a capacity measurement.
